lots.title: Lift Servicing, Maintenance, Repair, Minor Refurbishment and Compliance Management
lots.description: Draft Terms and Conditions template for Lot 7 of London Borough of Bexley Framework 6278 (Building Services Framework). The document sets out Part 1 Form of Contract, Part 2 General Terms and Conditions, and Part 3 Special Terms and Conditions for the provision of Lift Services to the Council, including servicing, maintenance, repair, minor refurbishment works and compliance management. Schedule 1 Specification, Schedule 2 Pricing Schedule, Schedule 3 Council's Invitation to Tender and Schedule 4 Contractor's Tender are appended as empty placeholder headings only; the substantive scope, KPIs, CPV codes and evaluation criteria live in those schedules, which are not populated in this draft.
requirements: Provision of lift servicing, maintenance, repair, minor refurbishment and compliance management to the London Borough of Bexley in accordance with the Specification set out at Schedule 1 (S2.1, S2.4).

Services to be performed during Working Hours for the Contract Period with reasonable skill, care and diligence and in accordance with the Specification, Council instructions and Council Policies (S2.1).
Contractor shall service the Plant and maintain it in good working order in accordance with any manufacturer's guarantees or recommendations (S2.4).

Contractor to provide all Equipment necessary for the supply of the Services, at its own risk, and keep it in safe, serviceable and clean condition; Equipment shall not be delivered to Premises without prior written Council approval (B2.1-B2.6, S9.1-S9.3).
Contractor to comply with all Quality Standards and maintain accreditation with the relevant Quality Standards authorisation body where applicable (B3.1).

All Staff engaged in the Services shall have the relevant and appropriate qualifications and be competent, skilled, honest and experienced; Staff operating vehicles and equipment must be suitably qualified (B4.2).

Contractor shall register with the Disclosure and Barring Service and undertake appropriate criminal records checks where required by the Specification, with rechecks at least every three years (B4.11).
Contractor shall appoint a suitably qualified, competent and experienced Contract Manager, fluent in English, available during specified operating hours (B6.1).

Contractor shall perform the duties of principal designer and principal contractor under the CDM Regulations to the extent applicable to the Services, including preparation of the Construction Phase Plan and Health and Safety File (S2.3).

Contractor must not specify or use materials known to be deleterious or contravening BSI Group / European directive standards, nor materials outside the BCO 'Good Practice in Selection of Construction Materials' guidance (S2.6).

All materials and goods supplied as part of the Services shall be as specified in the Specification; where not specified they shall be of the best available quality suitable for the purpose and comply with the latest applicable British Standard (S5.1).
Contractor shall comply with Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 duties and maintain a COSHH register at the Premises for all substances brought onto site (S3.4, S3.5).
Contractor shall provide environmental compliance and comply with the Council's environmental policies and relevant environmental law (D5).

Contractor, as Processor, shall comply with Data Protection Legislation including UK GDPR and Data Protection Act 2018, and shall implement appropriate Protective Measures (E1.1, A1 Protective Measures).
Contract Price shall be fixed for the duration of the Contract Period subject to C4.1, with invoicing monthly in arrears and payment within 30 days of valid invoice (C1.1, C2.1, C2.2).
Contractor shall comply with the Public Procurement (Electronic Invoices etc.) Regulations 2019 electronic invoicing standard and the Council's Tungsten Network requirements (C1.3, C1.4).
Contractor shall pay valid sub-contractor invoices within 30 days and include equivalent provisions in sub-contracts (C2.10).
Contractor shall evaluate and bear the risk of the Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations 2006 (TUPE) applying to the Contract (S1.1-S1.5).
Contractor and Sub-Contractors shall comply with all EU regulations, Acts of Parliament, HSE/HSC codes of practice, pollution controls and Council rules applicable to the Premises (S2.2.1-S2.2.4).

Dispute resolution by adjudication under the Scheme for Construction Contracts SI 1998/649 (as amended by SI 2011/2333) and arbitration under the CIMAR Rules via the Chartered Institute of Building (S10.1-S10.6).

Contractor to support Best Value obligations under the Local Government Act 1999, including continuous improvement, benchmarking and reporting emerging technologies and process improvements (B8.1-B8.5).
KPIs and Service Credits regime in the event of inadequate performance, with Service Credits deducted from monthly invoices (F5, C2.2, C3A).

warnings.message: Schedule 1 (Specification), Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule), Schedule 3 (Council's ITT) and Schedule 4 (Contractor's Tender) appear in the document only as placeholder headings with no content. Product scope, KPIs, quantities and evaluation criteria are therefore not derivable from this draft and must be sourced from the published tender pack or related documents in the document set.

The document is a Draft Terms and Conditions template and does not contain award/evaluation criteria, weightings or scoring methodology. KPI and remedies framework exists at F5 but is scheme-level (Service Credits), not award-criteria level.
